verdict.rationale: Morph documents a standard OpenAI-compatible endpoint (api.morphllm.com/v1) that any OpenAI SDK can point to, explicitly enabling switching models/providers (e.g., moving off Anthropic/OpenAI onto Kimi K3) by just changing the model string, plus a canary mechanism to trial traffic before fully switching — directly matching the mid-workflow provider-switch story. Community evidence corroborates the OpenAI-compatible endpoint working with third-party CLI tools. Missing for 10: independent verification of seamless mid-session provider switching without any code changes beyond model name, and no OpenAPI spec confirming full API parity.
